body.summary: The committee discussed an amendment related to government oversight and the First Amendment, with members debating whether the Biden administration has weaponized federal agencies against private entities and the press. The discussion was heated and partisan, with accusations of hypocrisy from both sides. The chair recognized several members to speak on the issue, but no vote was taken. The committee will continue to discuss the amendment and potentially vote on it later.
bill_references: Unnamed amendment being discussed by the committee
body.neutral_editorial_summary: A congressional committee held a discussion on an amendment related to government oversight and the First Amendment. The debate was characterized by accusations of hypocrisy from both sides, with some members arguing that the majority Republicans have not taken action on these issues in the past.
